# Feature: Scenario Engine

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-13 — issue #15 -->

## Intent
Without a phase model, runs are not comparable. The engine models Setup/Warm-up/Measure/Cleanup, repetitions, markers, and timeouts (FR-009/010). Quick Scan is a preset scenario, not a hidden special path.

## Preconditions
- `packages/schemas` exists (#4)

## Happy Path
- [x] Scenario schema enforces setup/warm-up/measure/cleanup (measure must not be empty)
- [x] Fake-driver test runs three repetitions and writes phase events
- [x] secretRefs store names only, no literal secrets
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)

## Edge Cases
- [x] Missing measure window is not savable
- [x] Timeout aborts phase without baseline eligibility

## Regression
- [x] Existing packages and `pnpm checks` stay green
- [x] Scope: `packages/scenario-engine/**`

## Assumptions
- YAML/JSON scenario input
- Fake driver is sufficient for MVP
- Quick Scan is a preset, not a special path

## Security Coverage
- B-04 N/A; secretRefs are names only
- No eval/exec of scenario code
- P-02: errors do not leak internal paths

## Screenshots
Not applicable.

## Implementation Notes
- `packages/scenario-engine/` holds schema (Zod), engine, and fake driver.
- Scenario requires non-empty measure; repetitions are bounded.
- Timeout uses `Promise.race` against driver.execute; abort marks `baselineEligible: false`.
- `secretRef` is a string name only; no literal secrets.
- All 49 tests pass; `pnpm checks` is green.
